posts.body_html: some updated pics of S. Reptilian rose, photos taken 7/26/23. Many incredible hybrids have been made using this as a parent! Many wonder where does that kinked lip trait come from, and I'll have to defer the answer to Philcula aka Phil Faulisi, who made this incredible hybrid.
